text: This report outlines the Recommended 2019 Solid Waste Management Services Rates and Fees arising from the concurrent adoption of the 2019 Recommended Solid Waste Management Services Operating and Capital Budgets. Recommended rate and fee increases will vary based on customer group. Table 1 highlights the recommended key Solid Waste Management Services Rates and Fees effective retroactive to January 1, 2019.
